## Outcome
Done: fixed the off-by-one bug in `reserve` in `src/inventory.ts`, and both inventory tests now pass.

## Changes
- `src/inventory.ts`: `reserve` rejected requests that would take the last units (`have <= qty`). Changed the guard to `have < qty` so it takes `qty` units whenever that many are left.

Diff:
```diff
-	if (have <= qty) { return false; }
+	if (have < qty) { return false; }
```

## Verification
Ran `node --test test/inventory.test.ts`: 2 pass, 0 fail (`inStock` and `reserve can take the last units`).

## Open issues
None for this file. Note that the `checkout` test failure is separate: `checkout.ts` ignores the `false` return from `reserve` (`continue`), so it doesn't throw "out of stock". That belongs to the checkout subagent's file, and I did not touch it.
